# Vikasa Services & Interiors

> Vikasa Services & Interiors (vikasaservices.in) is Tamil Nadu's trusted destination for turnkey interior design, modular kitchens, custom plywood craftsmanship, and on-demand verified technicians. Serving Erode, Coimbatore, Salem, Tiruppur, and across Tamil Nadu.

## Core Capabilities

- **Modular Kitchens**: Custom kitchens fabricated with 100% IS:710 boiling waterproof (BWP) marine plywood, scratch-resistant acrylic and high-pressure laminate shutters, soft-close hardware, quartz countertops, and ergonomic tandem pull-outs.
- **Custom Wardrobes & Storage**: Floor-to-ceiling sliding, openable, and walk-in wardrobes with calibrated plywood cores, anti-warp profile handles, smoked glass displays, and concealed warm LED lighting.
- **Living Room & TV Entertainment Consoles**: Statement living room media walls with acoustic fluted paneling, floating wooden consoles, Italian marble textures, ambient cove lighting, and concealed wire management.
- **False Ceiling & Architectural Lighting**: Designer gypsum and POP false ceilings with recessed spotlights, ambient cove profiles, and magnetic track lighting.
- **Verified Home Trade Services**: On-demand verified professionals for carpentry, electrical wiring, plumbing, wall painting, and AC repairs dispatched via central operator coordinators.

## Service Locations in Tamil Nadu

- **Primary Service Hub**: Erode City, Tamil Nadu (PIN: 638001).
- **Erode Localities**: Perundurai Road, Thindal, Bhavani, Gobichettipalayam, Chithode, Modakkurichi, Veerappanchatram, Surampatti, Solar, Komarapalayam, Perundurai SIPCOT.
- **Extended Service Areas**: Coimbatore, Salem, Tiruppur, Namakkal, and outstation turnkey projects across Tamil Nadu.

## Quality & Specifications

- **Plywood Grade**: 100% 710-grade Boiling Waterproof (BWP) Marine Plywood with calibrated thickness and termite/borer resistance.
- **Machining**: Factory CNC cutting, multi-roller edge-banding, and dust-minimized on-site installation.
- **Coordination Model**: Central operator-managed dispatch. Direct human verification ensures technician quality and customer contact privacy.
